title: Extra-Guest Share: Damage-Loss Addition from HostCover Property-Damage Losses (Listings)
content:
# Extra-Guest Share — Damage-Loss Addition

*Allowance schedule for Roamhaven Listings, read against the listing's Host Damage Protection (HostCover) claims.*

On top of the standard extra-guest share, a listing may carry a damage-loss addition, worked out on the day of the extra-guest fee reset. It rests on the verified losses of the Host Damage Protection (HostCover) claims in the property damage category that the claims team approved and that were filed on the listing within the damage look-back. Those verified losses are added up:

| Verified losses of those claims, added up | Added to the listing's extra-guest share |
|---|---|
| $2500.00 or more | 0.15 |
| above zero but below $2500.00 | 0.08 |
| none | nothing |

## Cases (hypothetical claims within the look-back)

- Verified losses of $1800.00 and $700.00: together $2500.00, which is "$2500.00 or more": 0.15.
- A single verified loss of $2499.99: above zero but below $2500.00: 0.08.
- An approved property-damage claim whose verified loss stands at $0.00, and nothing else: no losses, nothing added.
- Only a denied property-damage claim: not approved, nothing added.
